title: The Echo-Vault Where Power Reads Itself

features.name: the reading-row
features.desc-on-touch: Transformers stand in ranks, each one pointed inward to listen to the next. They've begun translating current into narrative—you hear them tell each other stories about the power that flows between.

features.name: the feedback-spiral
features.desc-on-touch: A structure that echoes power back into itself, spiraling inward. It grows louder the more it listens to its own voice. The corruption has made it remember every signal it's ever amplified.

features.name: the vault-mouth
features.desc-on-touch: An opening into chambers where power once lived before it learned to dream. The copper inside is tarnished with meanings—corrosion that speaks in the voltage's own language.

features.name: the current-memory
features.desc-on-touch: Cabling coiled in a way that suggests it's written something. The pattern isn't random—it encodes flows that happened years ago, locked in copper, still conducting backwards through time.

inscription: power learned that reading itself is a kind of touching
